rule: Two columns that never borrow from each other: SIGNAL (did the call beat a coin flip, with n and CI) and STAKING (what it would have returned at a real price). A lucky staking run cannot promote a bad signal, because promotion reads the signal column.

demotion_gates.rule: |r| > 0.8 with an existing live strategy and < 200 independent bets

demotion_gates.rule: Any input row fails the source gate on two consecutive builds

demotion_gates.name: Regime break
